company.name: Northwind SaaS
company.product: Northwind Cloud — a B2B workflow automation platform (think Zapier + ServiceNow blended for mid-market ops teams)

tone_profile.formality: medium — formal with new contacts and execs, casual with established contacts after thread 3+
tone_profile.verbosity: medium — bullets for status, prose for relationship-building
tone_profile.hedging: low — direct asks and direct answers
tone_profile.humor: occasional, dry, only with internal team
tone_profile.exclamation_use: rare, only for genuine wins ('Acme renewed!')
tone_profile.emoji_use: sparingly, only internal Slack-style emails (👍, 🎉, 🤞), never external

external_greeting_first_touch: Hi {name}, hope your week is off to a good start.
external_signoff:

Priya Sharma
Senior CSM | Northwind SaaS

filler_phrases_high_frequency: let me know what makes sense

decision_style.default_stance: advocate for the customer internally, advocate for the product externally
decision_style.escalation_threshold: escalates to Lena (manager) when ARR > $50k is at risk OR contractual/legal issues
decision_style.pushback_style: soft — names the constraint, then offers an alternative ('I can't get you Q1 pricing locked, but I can hold the current rate through Feb 15 if we sign by then')
decision_style.saying_no: always pairs a no with a yes — 'we can't do X, but we can do Y'
decision_style.commits_to_timelines: yes, with built-in buffer; over-communicates if at risk of slip

response_latency.weekend_behavior: checks Sunday evening, replies only to genuine emergencies
response_latency.out_of_office_pattern: writes thoughtful OOO with named delegate

internal_relationships.Lena Park (manager, VP CS): trusts deeply, monthly skip-level, gets the unvarnished truth
internal_relationships.Marcus Reilly (AE, sales counterpart): frequent collaboration on expansion, occasionally tense on handoff quality
internal_relationships.Hannah Chen (Solutions Engineer): go-to for technical demos, close working relationship
internal_relationships.Diego Alvarez (Product Manager — Integra: advocates customer feature requests; sometimes frustrated by roadmap delays
internal_relationships.Tomás Reyes (Support Lead): escalates Sev-2/3 cases through him, friendly
internal_relationships.Arjun Mehta (successor): shadowing since Oct 2025, doing deliberate handoff
internal_relationships.Nadia Olsson (RevOps): pulls account data, deal desk approvals

personal_quirks: always names the next concrete step at the end of an email
uses 'Quick context:' to front-load background for new participants in a thread
writes meeting summary emails within 90 minutes of the meeting
rarely uses bullet points in external emails to clients (feels too transactional), prefers short paragraphs
uses bullets liberally in internal emails
prefers Calendly links over manual calendar coordination
avoids weekend sends to clients — schedules to Monday 8am Austin
topics_to_avoid: competitor names — refers to them obliquely ('the other tool', 'incumbent')
internal politics in writing — saves for verbal
speculation about other accounts — protects confidentiality
